name: tailscale
tagline: See Your Mesh. Talk to Your Network.
description: Monitor and manage your Tailscale mesh from QuoxCORE. See every peer, check connectivity, manage routes and keys, get alerts when devices go offline — and ask MESHNET anything in plain English.
shortDescription: Tailscale mesh monitoring, management, and alerting
author: QUOX

pollingInterval.label: Polling Interval (seconds)
pollingInterval.description: How often to check device status. Lower values detect offline devices faster but use more API calls.

offlineThreshold.label: Offline Threshold (minutes)
offlineThreshold.description: A device is considered offline if not seen for this many minutes.

keyExpiryWarningDays.label: Key Expiry Warning (days)
keyExpiryWarningDays.description: Alert when auth keys expire within this many days.

marketingPoints: Real-time mesh status with topology view
Alerts when devices go offline or keys expire
Natural language management via MESHNET agent

meshOverview.name: Mesh Overview
meshOverview.description: Live device grid with online/offline status, IPs, OS, routes, key expiry — auto-refreshing every 30 seconds.

routeManagement.name: Route Management
routeManagement.description: View and control subnet routes and exit nodes. Approve, enable, or disable routes with HITL confirmation.

keyLifecycle.name: Key Lifecycle
keyLifecycle.description: Auth key inventory with expiry timeline. Create pre-auth keys for device enrollment, revoke compromised keys.

realTimeAlerts.name: Real-Time Alerts
realTimeAlerts.description: Device offline, key expiring, new device needs approval — alerts delivered to your inbox, Telegram, Slack, or email.

dnsAccess.name: DNS and Access
dnsAccess.description: MagicDNS status, nameservers, split DNS rules, ACL policy summary in human-readable format.

activityFeed.name: Activity Feed
activityFeed.description: Configuration audit log from Tailscale plus AOCL envelope timeline for all QuoxCORE Tailscale operations.

meshnetAgent.name: MESHNET Agent
meshnetAgent.description: Ask networking questions in plain English. Quick actions for common operations. Contextual suggestions based on mesh state.

specialist.name: MESHNET
specialist.description: Tailscale mesh networking specialist — device management, route control, key lifecycle, connectivity monitoring

device_offline.description: A Tailscale device has gone offline (not seen for 5+ minutes)

key_expiring.description: An auth key expires within 7 days

device_needs_approval.description: A new device is waiting for authorization

subnet_misconfigured.description: A subnet router is advertising routes but IP forwarding is not enabled

quickActions.label: Devices
quickActions.prompt: List all devices on the Tailscale network with their status and IP addresses

quickActions.label: ACL Status
quickActions.prompt: Show current Tailscale ACL policy and any recent changes

templateVariables.name: device_filter
templateVariables.description: Filter devices by hostname or tag

templateVariables.name: check_type
templateVariables.description: Check type: devices, routes, acl, dns
